name: Theme RGB
author: huacnlee
description: Your theme, on every light. Keeps every device OpenRGB manages — keyboard, mouse, RAM, fans, strips — in the colours of the current Omarchy theme, on theme switch and at login. Pick one theme colour or a set of them from the bar, and how they lie across a keyboard.

barWidget.description: Palette glyph in the bar; click to choose how many of the theme's colours light your devices, how they lie on a keyboard, and how bright.
